recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下，中央擴張的淋巴竇內充滿大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡嗜酸性，核圓形空泡狀、有小核仁，細胞質內可見小淋巴球；兩側為淋巴球與漿細胞密集的髓索，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Expanded sinus filled with large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, ill-defined cytoplasm
Round vesicular histiocyte nuclei with small distinct nucleoli and minimal atypia
Small lymphocytes and plasma cells scattered within histiocyte cytoplasm, suggestive of emperipolesis
Flanking cords rich in small lymphocytes and plasma cells
No necrosis, eosinophil-rich infiltrate, or mitotic activity evident
describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows sinuses markedly expanded by large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei containing small nucleoli. Scattered lymphocytes and plasma cells appear within the histiocyte cytoplasm, suggestive of emperipolesis, and the adjacent medullary cords contain many plasma cells and small lymphocytes. There is no significant nuclear atypia, necrosis, or eosinophilia. Findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease; confirmation requires S100 positivity with CD1a negativity in the histiocytes.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytes are smaller, lack emperipolesis, and are S100-negative.
LCH shows grooved, folded nuclei with eosinophils and is CD1a/langerin positive.
ALCL cells show horseshoe nuclei with marked atypia and are CD30/ALK positive rather than bland S100-positive histiocytes.
